build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that generates scenes with two jars and balls to topple
create_jar_with_ball: create a jar with a ball inside using the PHYRE scene creator API
add_static_bar: add a static bar obstacle to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and angle
add_dynamic_jar: add a dynamic jar object to the PHYRE scene at a specific position and angle
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require two balls touching as the solution goal
